text.10:16: Say: If Allah had so willed I should not have recited it to you nor would He have made it known to you. I dwelt among you a whole lifetime before it (came to me). Have ye then no sense?
text.33:63: Men ask thee of the Hour. Say: The knowledge of it is with Allah only. What can convey (the knowledge) unto thee? It may be that the Hour is nigh.
text.42:17: Allah it is Who hath revealed the Scripture with truth, and the Balance. How canst thou know? It may be that the Hour is nigh.
text.69:3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!
text.74:27: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -
text.77:14: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
text.80:3: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
text.82:17: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
text.82:18: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
text.83:8: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
text.83:19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -
text.86:2: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
text.90:12: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
text.97:2: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!
text.101:3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!
text.101:10: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
text.104:5: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
